title: Ephesians Chapter 3 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Ephesians chapter 3 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Ephesians Chapter 3 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Ephesians Chapter 3.

questions.question: In Ephesians 3, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: Paul is a prisoner of Jesus Christ
The gift of grace was given
questions.correctAnswer: Paul is a prisoner of Jesus Christ
questions.explanation: This is stated first in Ephesians 3:1 where Paul identifies himself as a prisoner.

questions.question: Who is the author of the letter to the Ephesians?
questions.explanation: Paul identifies himself as the author in Ephesians 3:1.

questions.question: To whom is Paul a prisoner for?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:1 states that Paul is a prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles.

questions.question: What has been given to Paul for the Gentiles?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:2 mentions the dispensation of the grace of God given to Paul for the Gentiles.

questions.question: How was the mystery made known to Paul?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:3 states that the mystery was made known to Paul by revelation.

questions.question: What does Paul encourage the readers to do when they read his writings?
options: Understand his knowledge in the mystery of Christ
questions.correctAnswer: Understand his knowledge in the mystery of Christ
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:4 states that when they read, they may understand Paul's knowledge in the mystery of Christ.

questions.question: In what ages was the mystery not made known?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:5 indicates that the mystery was not made known in other ages.

questions.question: Who revealed the mystery to his holy apostles and prophets?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:5 states that the mystery is now revealed by the Spirit.

questions.question: What are the Gentiles to be according to the promise in Christ?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:6 states that Gentiles should be fellowheirs of the promise in Christ.

questions.question: What role was Paul given according to Ephesians 3:7?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:7 states that Paul was made a minister according to the gift of grace.

questions.question: The grace of God was given to Paul according to what?
options: The effectual working of God's power
questions.correctAnswer: The effectual working of God's power
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:7 mentions that the grace of God was given to Paul by the effectual working of His power.

questions.question: True or False: Paul refers to himself as a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:1 states that Paul is a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

questions.question: True or False: The mystery was revealed to Paul by the Spirit.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:5 indicates that the mystery was revealed by the Spirit.

questions.question: True or False: Paul was made a king according to the gift of grace.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:7 states that Paul was made a minister, not a king.

questions.question: True or False: The Gentiles were promised to be servants of the law.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:6 states that the Gentiles are fellowheirs, not servants of the law.

medium.title: Ephesians Chapter 3 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Ephesians Chapter 3 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Ephesians 3:8, what grace was given to Paul?
options: To preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ
To perform miracles among the Jews
To write letters to the churches
To lead the Israelites out of Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: To preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:8 states that Paul was given grace to preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ.

questions.question: What does Ephesians 3:10 promise will happen if the church reveals the manifold wisdom of God?
options: The principalities and powers in heavenly places will be made known by the church
The church will become wealthy and powerful
The Gentiles will be excluded from the promise
The apostles will receive special visions
questions.correctAnswer: The principalities and powers in heavenly places will be made known by the church
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:10 explains that the manifold wisdom of God will be known by the principalities and powers in heavenly places through the church.

questions.question: What is described as 'the fellowship of the mystery' in Ephesians 3:9?
options: The unity of Jews and Gentiles in Christ
The special bond among the apostles
The relationship between angels and humans
questions.correctAnswer: The unity of Jews and Gentiles in Christ
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:9 talks about the mystery which was hidden but now revealed: that Gentiles are fellowheirs and partakers of the promise in Christ, indicating unity.

questions.question: How does Ephesians 3:11 relate to the purpose described in Ephesians 3:10?
options: It states the wisdom of God is according to the eternal purpose in Christ Jesus our Lord
It commands the church to fast and pray
It describes the punishment of principalities and powers
It explains the origin of the gospel
questions.correctAnswer: It states the wisdom of God is according to the eternal purpose in Christ Jesus our Lord
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:11 clarifies that the manifold wisdom of God known by principalities and powers is according to the eternal purpose purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord, showing cause and effect.

questions.question: What kind of access do believers have according to Ephesians 3:12?
options: Boldness and access with confidence by the faith of Him
questions.correctAnswer: Boldness and access with confidence by the faith of Him
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:12 states believers have boldness and confident access through faith in Christ Jesus.

questions.question: Why does Paul desire that believers do not faint at his tribulations, as mentioned in Ephesians 3:13?
options: Because his tribulations are for their glory
Because he will soon be released
Because they will be rewarded with riches
questions.correctAnswer: Because his tribulations are for their glory
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:13 explains that Paul's tribulations are for the believers' glory, encouraging them not to faint.

questions.question: In Ephesians 3:14, to whom does Paul bow his knees?
options: The Father of our Lord Jesus Christ
questions.correctAnswer: The Father of our Lord Jesus Christ
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:14 states that Paul bows his knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

questions.question: What gift does Paul say he was given according to Ephesians 3:7?
options: The gift of the grace of God by the effectual working of His power
The gift of speaking in tongues
questions.correctAnswer: The gift of the grace of God by the effectual working of His power
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:7 reveals Paul was made a minister according to the gift of the grace of God given by the effectual working of His power.

questions.question: What revelation did Paul receive as described in Ephesians 3:3?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:3 states that by revelation Paul was made known the mystery of Christ.

questions.question: According to Ephesians 3:6, what is the status of the Gentiles in the promise of Christ?
options: Fellowheirs, of the same body, and partakers of his promise
Only believers from Jewish descent qualify
questions.correctAnswer: Fellowheirs, of the same body, and partakers of his promise
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:6 reveals that Gentiles share equally as fellowheirs and partakers of the promise in Christ.

questions.question: What should believers understand when they read Paul's words, according to Ephesians 3:4?
options: Paul's knowledge in the mystery of Christ
The laws of the Old Testament
questions.correctAnswer: Paul's knowledge in the mystery of Christ
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:4 states that when believers read Paul's words, they may understand his knowledge in the mystery of Christ.

questions.question: How was the mystery revealed to the holy apostles and prophets, according to Ephesians 3:5?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:5 explains the mystery was revealed by the Spirit to the holy apostles and prophets.

questions.question: True or False: Paul refers to himself as 'less than the least of all saints' in Ephesians 3:8.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:8 explicitly states Paul considers himself less than the least of all saints.

questions.question: True or False: According to Ephesians 3:12, believers gain access through their own works and rituals.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:12 states access is by the faith of Him (Jesus Christ), not by works or rituals.

questions.question: True or False: Ephesians 3:13 encourages believers to be discouraged by Paul's tribulations for them.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:13 encourages believers not to faint or be discouraged at Paul's tribulations because they are for their glory.

hard.title: Ephesians Chapter 3 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Ephesians Chapter 3.

questions.question: What is the family in heaven and earth named after?
questions.explanation: The whole family in heaven and earth is named after the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, as stated in Ephesians 3:15.

questions.question: According to Ephesians 3:16, what is granted to the believers?
options: Strengthened with might by his Spirit
questions.correctAnswer: Strengthened with might by his Spirit
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:16 states that he would grant you to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man.

questions.question: What must dwell in our hearts according to Ephesians 3:17?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:17 says that Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith.

questions.question: What dimensions does Paul want believers to comprehend in Ephesians 3:18?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:18 mentions comprehending the breadth, length, depth, and height, which refers to the love of Christ.

questions.question: What does Ephesians 3:19 say believers might be filled with?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:19 states that believers might be filled with all the fullness of God.

questions.question: What is God able to do according to Ephesians 3:20?
options: Do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think
questions.correctAnswer: Do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:20 expresses that God is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think.

questions.question: What does the Greek word 'dynamis' in Ephesians 3:20 mean?
questions.explanation: 'Dynamis' translates to 'power,' which refers to the divine ability that works in believers, as seen in Ephesians 3:20.

questions.question: Which literary device is used in Ephesians 3:18 when discussing dimensions?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:18 uses parallelism as it lists the dimensions of love through a series of four descriptors.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage connects to the theme of God's love in Ephesians 3:19?
questions.explanation: 1 John 4:8 states that God is love, connecting directly to the theme of knowing the love of Christ in Ephesians 3:19.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage connects to the theme of believers being rooted in love in Ephesians 3:17?
questions.explanation: Colossians 2:7 mentions being rooted and built up in Christ, echoing the sentiment in Ephesians 3:17 about being rooted in love.

questions.question: What comes before Ephesians 3:15?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:14 states that Paul bows his knees unto the Father, which directly precedes the statement in verse 15.

questions.question: What is the significance of the phrase 'the whole family' in Ephesians 3:15?
questions.explanation: The phrase 'the whole family' in Ephesians 3:15 encompasses all believers, both in heaven and on earth.

questions.question: God is glorified in the church through whom, according to Ephesians 3:21?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:21 states that unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus.

questions.question: True or False: Ephesians 3:20 indicates that God can only do what we ask or think.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:20 states that God is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, indicating His power goes beyond our requests.

questions.question: True or False: Ephesians 3:21 emphasizes the eternal glory of God in the church.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:21 indeed emphasizes that glory be unto Him throughout all ages, affirming His eternal glory in the church.

theological.title: Ephesians Chapter 3 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Ephesians Chapter 3 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does Ephesians 3:6 teach about salvation?
options: Gentiles are fellowheirs and partakers of the promise in Christ
Salvation is only for the Jewish people
The promise is exclusive to the apostles and prophets
Salvation is based on works and human effort
questions.correctAnswer: Gentiles are fellowheirs and partakers of the promise in Christ
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:6 explicitly states that the Gentiles are fellowheirs, members of the same body, and partakers of the promise in Christ by the gospel, affirming the inclusion of Gentiles in salvation.

questions.question: What doctrine does Ephesians 3:8 teach regarding the grace of God given to Paul?
options: Paul was given grace to preach the unsearchable riches of Christ among the Gentiles
Paul considered himself the greatest of all saints
Grace was given to Paul to establish the law among Jews
Paul’s grace was to separate Jews from Gentiles
questions.correctAnswer: Paul was given grace to preach the unsearchable riches of Christ among the Gentiles
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:8 reveals that Paul, though less than the least of saints, was granted grace to preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ, emphasizing the grace-based mission to Gentiles.

questions.question: What doctrine does Ephesians 3:17 teach about sanctification?
options: Christ dwells in believers’ hearts by faith, rooting them in love
Sanctification is achieved through strict adherence to the law
Sanctification depends on human wisdom and strength
Believers are sanctified by rituals and sacrifices
questions.correctAnswer: Christ dwells in believers’ hearts by faith, rooting them in love
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:17 teaches that sanctification involves Christ indwelling believers’ hearts through faith, making them rooted and grounded in love, which is essential for spiritual growth.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does verse 3:5 specifically demonstrate?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:5 shows God’s revelatory omniscience by revealing the previously hidden mystery to the apostles and prophets by the Spirit.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does verse 3:20 specifically demonstrate?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:20 highlights God’s omnipotence, affirming that He is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think by His power working in us.

questions.question: How does Ephesians 3:11 connect to the broader biblical narrative?
options: It affirms God’s eternal purpose in Christ Jesus, fulfilling the covenant promises to Israel
It suggests God changes His purposes frequently
It denies any connection between the Old and New Testament
It claims that Jesus is a minor figure in God’s plan
questions.correctAnswer: It affirms God’s eternal purpose in Christ Jesus, fulfilling the covenant promises to Israel
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:11 states that God’s eternal purpose was purposed in Christ Jesus, reflecting the fulfillment of covenant promises made throughout Scripture.

questions.question: How does Ephesians 3:9 contribute to the redemptive-historical theme of mystery revelation?
options: It reveals the hidden fellowship of the mystery, previously concealed since creation
It claims the mystery was known to all men in all ages
It denies any mystery in God’s plan
It teaches that mysteries are irrelevant to the church
questions.correctAnswer: It reveals the hidden fellowship of the mystery, previously concealed since creation
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:9 describes the mystery of Christ’s fellowship as hidden in God since the beginning but now revealed, connecting to the progressive revelation theme in redemptive history.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses 3:12 and 3:14 teach about prayer and access to God?
options: Believers have boldness and confident access to God through faith, prompting prayer in the Spirit
Prayer is ineffective and access to God is restricted
Access to God requires ritual sacrifices
Boldness in prayer depends on human merit
questions.correctAnswer: Believers have boldness and confident access to God through faith, prompting prayer in the Spirit
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:12 speaks of boldness and confident access by faith in Christ, while 3:14 shows Paul praying to the Father, indicating prayer flows from this confident access.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses 3:16 and 3:19 teach about the Spirit and Christian fullness?
options: The Spirit strengthens believers inwardly so they may know Christ’s love and be filled with God’s fullness
The Spirit is irrelevant to Christian growth
Christian fullness is attained by knowledge alone
Christ’s love is limited and measurable
questions.correctAnswer: The Spirit strengthens believers inwardly so they may know Christ’s love and be filled with God’s fullness
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:16 talks about being strengthened by the Spirit in the inner man, and 3:19 about comprehending Christ’s love and being filled with God’s fullness, showing Spirit-enabled sanctification and fullness.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses 3:1 and 3:7 teach about Paul’s apostolic ministry?
options: Paul’s ministry to the Gentiles is a grace gift empowered by God’s power
Paul’s ministry is based on human wisdom and status
Paul was forced into ministry against his will
questions.correctAnswer: Paul’s ministry to the Gentiles is a grace gift empowered by God’s power
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:1 identifies Paul as a prisoner for the Gentiles, and 3:7 explains his ministry was given by grace and empowered by God’s power, emphasizing divine empowerment for apostolic mission.

questions.question: Skeptics claim Ephesians 3:10-11 teaches that spiritual principalities and powers are supreme over the church. What does the passage actually teach?
options: The church reveals the manifold wisdom of God to the principalities and powers
The principalities and powers have authority over the church
The church is ignorant of spiritual realities
God’s wisdom is hidden from all spiritual beings
questions.correctAnswer: The church reveals the manifold wisdom of God to the principalities and powers
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:10-11 states the church’s role is to make known God’s manifold wisdom to the spiritual principalities and powers, showing the church’s spiritual authority, not subjection.

questions.question: What doctrine does Ephesians 3:13 teach about suffering and Christian identity?
options: Believers share in Paul’s tribulations as a source of glory
Suffering is a sign of divine rejection
Tribulations are unrelated to Christian identity
Glory is only for those without suffering
questions.correctAnswer: Believers share in Paul’s tribulations as a source of glory
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:13 expresses that believers should not faint because Paul’s sufferings for them are their glory, indicating participation in suffering is part of Christian identity.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does verse 3:15 specifically demonstrate?
options: Sovereignty as the Father of all family in heaven and earth
questions.correctAnswer: Sovereignty as the Father of all family in heaven and earth
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:15 identifies God as the Father from whom all family in heaven and earth is named, highlighting His sovereign fatherhood over all creation.

questions.question: How does Ephesians 3:18 contribute to a theological understanding of the Christian life?
options: Believers can comprehend the vast dimensions of Christ’s love with all saints
The Christian life is limited to intellectual knowledge
The love of Christ is measurable and finite
Believers must comprehend all mysteries before faith
questions.correctAnswer: Believers can comprehend the vast dimensions of Christ’s love with all saints
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:18 speaks of comprehending the breadth, length, depth, and height of Christ’s love, pointing to the expansive and communal dimension of understanding God’s love.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses 3:2 and 3:3 teach about divine revelation?
options: The dispensation of God’s grace and the mystery were revealed to Paul by revelation
The mystery was discovered by human philosophy
God’s grace is hidden and inaccessible
Revelation is unnecessary for understanding salvation
questions.correctAnswer: The dispensation of God’s grace and the mystery were revealed to Paul by revelation
questions.explanation: Ephesians 3:2 refers to the dispensation of grace given to Paul, and 3:3 clarifies that the mystery was made known to him by revelation from God.
